review_comments.body: **Helper precedes the main export** `saveLlmRevision` sits between the imports and `noteTools`. `CLAUDE.md` requires helpers below the primary export they support so readers see the entry point first. Move it below `noteTools`, alongside `scanWrittenContent`, before merging to satisfy that requirement. **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md ([source](https://github.com/triliumnext/trilium/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
